# Roots
# @weight 15
# @timeout-scale 4

The roots x's TLS client trusts: Mozilla's, from lib/x/net/mozilla-roots.pem.
A root is found by a certificate's issuer, and the chains jrexpr.ca and
github.com served on 2026-10-11 verify against the file with the clock
held at 2026-10-15 00:00:00 UTC (1792022400).  github.com's stops at Sectigo
E46, which Mozilla trusts, before the cross-signature it sends.  The
chain checks build the P-256 and P-384 engines, so the file carries an
engine's weight.

## the file

### Mozilla's count, and a root found by the name an intermediate gives as its issuer

```x
(do
  (import x/net/roots)
  (import x/net/x509)
  (import x/codec/bytes)
  (def %rt-we1 (X509 parse (Bytes of-hex "")))
  (def %rt-found (Roots find (X509 issuer %rt-we1)))
  (write (list (Roots count) (List length %rt-found)
               (Bytes same? (X509 subject (first %rt-found)) (X509 issuer %rt-we1))
               (X509 signed-by? %rt-we1 (first %rt-found))
               (Roots find (Bytes of-hex "3000")))))
```
---
    (121 1 #t #t ())

## chains against Mozilla's roots

### jrexpr.ca and github.com, leaf and intermediate only

```x
(do
  (import x/net/roots)
  (import x/net/x509)
  (import x/codec/bytes)
  (def %rt-mozilla (fn (_ name) (Roots find name)))
  (write (list (X509 verify-chain (list (Bytes of-hex "") (Bytes of-hex "")) "jrexpr.ca" 1792022400 %rt-mozilla)
               (X509 verify-chain (list (Bytes of-hex "") (Bytes of-hex "")) "github.com" 1792022400 %rt-mozilla))))
```
---
    (#t #t)
